body: Easily train a good VC model with voice data <= 10 mins!
plain_description: **Turn a short voice recording into a custom voice model for speech or real-time voice changing.** Train with as little as 10 minutes of audio. Use the web interface to train and run voice conversion.
technical_description: A Python voice-conversion framework with a web interface for training and inference. It uses top-1 retrieval to replace input features with features from the training set, and supports real-time voice conversion and vocal separation through pymss/MSST. The README documents CPU, AMD/Intel, NVIDIA GPU, and Windows DirectML dependency options.
title: Retrieval-based Voice Conversion WebUI
